ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_weighted_advantage_gap_mean_normalized
ir.intuition: To improve novelty and leverage the preferred 'advantage_gap' signal, replaced max advantage blending with advantage gap weighting. Additionally, normalized by the mean rather than the sum of weights for better scale invariance and clipped margin to maintain stability. This change also adjusts the weighting scheme to use the signed advantage gap, capturing relative preference strength more directly, differentiating from prior max-advantage-based losses.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))
margin = lpw - lpl
scaled_margin = alpha * margin
clamped_margin = clamp(scaled_margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
weight_factor = abs(adv_gap)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss_per_pair = hinge * weight_factor * weight
weight_mean = mean(weight)
final_loss = sum(loss_per_pair) / (weight_mean + 1e-8)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    weight_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(ops.mul(hinge, weight_factor), weight)
    weight_mean = ops.mean(weight)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_per_pair), ops.add(weight_mean, 1e-8))
    return loss
